website.name: DIO to DIO
website.description: A reflexive research portfolio examining how large language models reconstruct Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and the Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI) when the framework is applied to its own distributed ecosystem.

project.name: DIO to DIO
project.description: An author-led reflexive research project using large language models to examine how Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and the Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI) are reconstructed when applied to their own distributed ecosystem. The author defines and directs the research; each report retains its own model-specific analytical approach and documented prompt arrangement. The reports are not ranked, harmonized, or synthesized.

dataset.name: DIO to DIO: Author-Led LLM Research Reports on DIO/ODI
dataset.description: A curated research dataset of author-led reports examining the distributed DIO/ODI ecosystem through large-language-model-assisted research. The author defines and directs the research; models provide distinct analyses under report-specific prompt arrangements. Each report is preserved as an unchanged Markdown and PDF source alongside a faithful HTML representation. The reports retain their own analytical approaches and are not ranked, harmonized, or synthesized.
